title: Solomon
summary: Son of David and Bathsheba; king of Israel 40 years; built and dedicated the Temple (1 Kgs 1–11).

sorting_basis.note: Tier 4: Ussher, Annals: 2971 AM, 1034 BC (no higher-tier year available).

birth.note: Not stated in the Jones sources read (Chart No. 1; Chronology of the Old Testament 15th ed. 2002, Chronological Compendium p. 1). Leave empty until verified.

birth.citation: Ussher, Annals of the World, Fourth Age §435 (paragraph numbering of the modern transcription)

birth.note: Not stated in the Jordan sources read (Biblical Horizons "Biblical Chronology" category, all 9 pages; garynorth.com archive of Biblical Chronology 1989-1996). Left empty, not inferred.

death.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 1: Problem, Data, and Methodology," ARJ 15 (2022): 377–390, section "Our Assumptions (Declared Biases)", Table 1 "Biblically derived dates from Ussher and Jones"
death.note: CFAH-1 Table 1 (Ussher-Jones biblical baseline adopted by CFAH); not a triangulated anchor point. CFAH-1 Conclusions note that their date for Solomon's death is a primary difference from other revisionists.
Jones Chart No. 1 gives "3029 AM 975 BC Kingdom DIVIDED" (not explicitly Solomon's death); no death year read in Jones.

death.citation: Ussher, Annals of the World, Fifth Age §475 (paragraph numbering of the modern transcription)

death.date: "After Solomon died in A.M. 3029, Rehoboam his son came to the throne"
death.citation: Jordan, "Solomon's Disastrous Geopolitics (Chronologies and Kings IV)," Biblical Chronology 3:10 (October 1991), section "The Egypt Factor"
death.note: Accession: "Solomon's accession to the throne in A.M. 2989" (BC 5:8, section "Egypt and the Kings of Israel") but "his first year was 2990" (BC 6:9 "Covenants and Dates") - Jordan is not consistent on this point. From Creation to Solomon (No. 2, 2001), ch. 11, p. 53: "2989 - Accession of Solomon." / "2990 - Solomon year 1."
